tools.name: list_accounts
tools.description: List every account the user has connected to Goptin (several per channel is normal). Call this first to pick the right account.

tools.name: list_conversations
tools.description: List recent inbox conversations (DMs, groups, channels, ticket threads), newest first, across all or one account.

tools.name: read_conversation
tools.description: Read the messages of one conversation, oldest first. Use `before` with the earliest sent_at to page back.

tools.name: search_messages
tools.description: Full-text search over stored messages across all or one account.

tools.name: send_message
tools.description: Send a message as the user into an existing conversation, through the account that conversation belongs to. This really delivers to the other person — confirm the text with the user first.

tools.name: list_tickets
tools.description: List tickets live from Jira / ClickUp with status, assignees, tags, list/sprint, parent, custom fields and linked tickets. Default: open tickets assigned to the user in their current sprint/list. ClickUp: pass list (e.g. "Sprint 102") and scope="anyone" for every ticket in a sprint, include_done for

tools.name: get_ticket
tools.description: Get one ticket live: full description, status, assignees, tags, parent, subtasks, linked tickets, attachments (with URLs), plus comments. Pass ticket_id (and account_id when you have several boards) from list_tickets, or a conversation_id. Synced tickets return the inbox thread including status/assi

tools.name: find_person
tools.description: Find a person by name, nickname or email across all accounts — ignores diacritics and word order ("Lena" finds "Le Na Nguyen" and "Nguyen Le Na"). Returns their identities per app, grouped when the names match, and the conversations they're in (DMs first).

tools.name: get_digest
tools.description: Read the user's latest daily digest (one per workspace): a summary of the last 24h across all accounts, tasks due today/overdue, high-priority tickets, and conversations waiting for the user's reply. Start the day here.

tools.name: list_tasks
tools.description: List the user's Goptin to-do list (manual, AI-extracted and ClickUp-synced tasks). Open tasks by default.

tools.name: create_task
tools.description: Add a task to the user's Goptin to-do list (private to the user, nothing is sent to anyone).

tools.name: complete_task
tools.description: Mark a Goptin task done (or reopen it with done=false). ClickUp-linked tasks are updated in ClickUp too.

tools.name: update_ticket
tools.description: Change a Jira/ClickUp ticket: move it to another status (use a status name shown by list_tickets), set the due date, or replace the description. Changes are visible to the user's team — confirm with the user first.

tools.name: comment_ticket
tools.description: Post a comment on a Jira/ClickUp ticket as the user. The team sees it — show the exact text to the user and confirm first.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_conversations, read_conversation, search_messages, list_tickets, get_ticket, get_digest · Private data: create_task · Public sink: send_message, find_person, comment_ticket.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_conversations, read_conversation, search_messages, list_tickets, get_ticket, get_digest · Private data: create_task · Public sink: send_message, find_person, comment_ticket

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
